decisions.base_branch: Based on docs/srd-fleet-project-manager rather than main: the SRD is unmerged, and the review console's /workspace is a live read-only mount of this checkout, so the spec must be present on the branch for a lens to read it.
decisions.isa_is_orchestrator_owned: ISA.md is never in an engineer's partition. Every branch in this repo edits it, so it is the whole conflict surface; the orchestrator writes it after each phase's merge.
decisions.fleet_yaml_is_not_dispatchable: fleet.yaml and fleet-development.yaml are gitignored (.gitignore:9). A worker told to edit them produces an empty diff, which ISC-93 grades as a fabrication. Task 1.1a is the operator's by hand.
decisions.engineer_isolation: Parallel engineers work in git worktrees and the orchestrator merges each branch. This is §6.2's model, so phases 1-5 exercise the integration path rather than deferring it to Phase 6.
